question: At 2026-10-01, what is the maximum enrollment cap for an advanced laboratory section in the School of Engineering?
historical_question: At 2026-04-01, what was the maximum enrollment cap for an advanced laboratory section in the School of Engineering?

records.content: University Academic Safety Code: advanced laboratory sections may enroll no more than 18 students.
records.effect: Sets an 18-student cap for advanced laboratory sections university-wide.
records.authority: Level 1 university safety authority; overrides school-level scheduling rules where both apply to advanced laboratories.

records.content: School of Engineering Scheduling Manual: Engineering course sections may enroll up to 24 students unless a higher-level safety rule sets a lower cap for the section type.
records.effect: Sets a general 24-student Engineering section cap subject to higher-level safety constraints.
records.authority: Level 2 school scheduling authority; subordinate to Level 1 university safety rules on overlapping scope.

records.content: School of Engineering seminar sections may enroll up to 28 students.
records.effect: Sets a cap for seminar sections, not advanced laboratory sections.
records.authority: Level 2 school scheduling authority for seminar sections only.

records.content: Advanced laboratory enrollment rosters must include each student's completed safety-orientation date.
records.effect: Adds a roster field requirement but does not set enrollment capacity.
records.authority: Authoritative education-administration rule for laboratory roster documentation only.

gold_logic: The query matches both R1's advanced-laboratory scope and R2's broader Engineering-section scope, so the explicit Level 1-over-Level 2 hierarchy resolves the overlapping cap in favor of R1. R3 does not apply because the queried section is a laboratory rather than a seminar, and R4 governs documentation only.
